result_text:
Contributor lists and the recent-contributors bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles offline, but there are no tests covering this path, so the behaviour is unverified beyond compilation.

Changes:

- **`reports/.../statichtml/LandscapeContributorsReport.java`** (`saveContributorsTable`): removed the `.limit(...)` on the table stream, the `limit` variable, and the "The list is limited to N items" paragraph. This covers All, Recently Active, bots and team pages.
- **`reports/.../statichtml/LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`** (`addRecentContributorsSection`): removed the `.limit(getContributorsListLimit())` on the recent-contributors bar chart, so there is one bar per recently active contributor.

The sort order is unchanged. `contributorsListLimit` stays in `LandscapeConfiguration` (default 1000) but is no longer read by any contributor code. The repository lists still use their own `repositoriesListLimit`, which I left alone since the task was about contributors.

Nothing is committed.
